entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David, how can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I think I need to return something, but I'm just so confused by the website. I have the VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly help you look into a return. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I'm sorry, I know it's probably too late. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived.
Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now. I'm very sorry to hear about your emergency. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, it's nothing wrong with the band, it's still in the box. My husband was rushed to the hospital. He had to have emergency surgery, and it was... well, it was a lot. I completely forgot about this package.
I understand completely, and I hope everything is alright now. Please take your time.

He's recovering, thank you. To make things more complicated, he's military, and his deployment schedule got all changed because of this. It's just been one thing after another. I don't think he can use it now. Can't you just help me? I don't know what the policy is.
Of course, I can help. It sounds like you've had a very stressful time. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. One moment.
Okay, I have your details here. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 22nd. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, 90 days? Really? I thought I read something much shorter online. Are you sure?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the return window, so there's no problem at all. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, that is such a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. With everything going on with the hospital and his deployment, this is one less thing to worry about.
I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, and you can drop the package off at any post office.
You're very welcome. We wish your husband a swift and full recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that was it. You've been wonderful.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
